name: Flamengo 2025 (Filipe Luís)
scopeNote: Flamengo under Filipe Luís in calendar 2025 (Supercopa Rei 2 Feb, Carioca, Brasileirão, Libertadores, Club World Cup in June, Copa do Brasil), managerId filipe-luis. Style term used by sources: Jogo de Posição (Trivela) / positional play with a narrow 4-2-3-1 / 4-4-2 (Soccerway, Drible de Corpo), 3-2 or 3-2-5 build-up (Trivela, Blueprint), mid-block 4-4-2 shifting to asymmetric 4-3-3 press in waves (TFA final). Popular label 'Simeone-style' is Filipe Luís's own influence claim; sources describe a possession team, not a counter-attacking one. Start date 2025-01-25 is the first Carioca match with the first team in Filipe Luís's charge (the 5th round v Volta Redonda), because Cleber dos Santos coached the U20 'alternative squad' in the first Carioca rounds (Soccerway BR, via manager file, not re-read) and 90min only forecast the 25 Jan date; the pre-season FC Series game v São Paulo was 19 Jan (friendly, not counted). End date 2025-12-17 (Intercontinental Cup final v PSG) comes from memory/search summary and is NOT verified; the last verified 2025 match in this research is the Libertadores final of 29 Nov 2025 (Danilo, 1-0). He was the only Flamengo manager in 2025 per the sources read, but no source states this explicitly. The false 3-4-3 v Atlético-MG is a Nov 2024 match, outside the period, kept unverified.
openQuestions: First and last competitive 2025 match dates are not verified: start 2025-01-25 (Volta Redonda) is from a forecast; end 2025-12-17 (Intercontinental) is unverified.
The false 3-4-3 v Atlético-MG (Alex Sandro between the Léos) is documented for 3 Nov 2024, not 2025; a 2025 repeat was not found.

Marking scheme: no source states Flamengo's own scheme. TFA final describes pair-matching in the press (striker v CB, interior v other CB, winger v full-back), i.e. man-oriented within a zonal 4-4-2; only Palmeiras are documented using individual marking. The 'Varela as free man' claim comes only from a video digest (recapio, tier D, unreadable).

Set pieces: the Rodrigo Caio effect is from a tier C radio-site article (Tupi, July 2025); no tier A-B study of routines, and nothing found on zonal v man at defensive set pieces beyond 5 conceded in the Brasileirão (Vavel via CIES-type data, vaguely worded).
Dismissal context (Mar 2026) is outside the period; Goal/Drible de Corpo Feb 2026 pieces describe 2026, not 2025.
Coaches' Voice, These Football Times and StatsBomb searches returned no Flamengo 2025 pages; Pedro, Plata, Bruno Henrique and De la Cruz roles are only touched by tier B/C mentions.
TFA group-stage-era claim of 'four goals conceded' is dated mid-June 2025 and refers to the Brasileirão start of the season; it is a snapshot, not a full-year figure.

statedView.quote: Os números para trás não me importam. Temos um time que sabe o caminho, como atacar e defender. Escolhemos essa ideia, jogadores compraram, a torcida gosta.

Bola parada é uma das fases do jogo, damos a importância que ela merece porque jogos bloqueados muitas vezes são desbloqueados na bola parada.
Dei os minutos quando eu pude dar os minutos. Nós viemos jogando a nossa vida praticamente todos os jogos lutando pela liderança e não tem tempo para revisar, não tem tempo para dar minutos.
Se gritar fora do campo ganhasse jogo, o Ancelotti não seria o treinador mais vitorioso da história
Nunca, jamais iria mudar o meu time de jogo por causa de um adversário.
O que a gente olha é a pressão alta. Só que para mim o jogo é feito de fases, então tem a fase defensiva que são quatro fases, que é o tiro de meta, a pressão alta, o bloco médio e o bloco baixo.
